clips.title: The story
paras: In Durotar, Taming Rods help novice hunters learn to command beasts. Trainers give them to students so they can practice before forming lasting bonds with animal companions.

In Razor Hill, trainers such as Thotar give Taming Rods to aspiring orc and troll hunters. These enchanted tools help novices who cannot yet bind a wild creature permanently. A rod pacifies a regional predator, such as a dire mottled boar or an armored scorpid, so the hunter can practice giving commands and fighting beside an animal companion. The bond lasts only briefly, leaving the student free to learn without forming a lasting tie to the beast.

Each Taming Rod's magic fades after a short while, and each is attuned to specific kinds of wild beasts. Novices face successive trials against different temperaments, from docile foragers to aggressive venomous hunters. When a student has shown they can command them, the rod goes back to the trainer. The trainer then teaches the student to tame, call, and dismiss lifelong companions without an artifact.
